messages:
liam_procurement: Heads up — vendor just flagged a partial DOA batch on the last H100 shipment. 6 units affected, serials listed below. vendor is proposing a split replace + depot repair flow. Can we decide a preferred path?

ana_logistics: Ugh, thanks. Can you paste the serials + AWB? need to check which DC they landed in and whether customs re-clearance will happen if we do air top-up.

liam_procurement: AWB: `EC123456789US`
Serials: H100-AX12, H100-AX13, H100-AX14, H100-AX15, H100-AX16, H100-AX17
Vendor note: 3 units available for air-express replacement next-day, rest need depot swap (ETA 7–10 business days).

maya_ops: If we accept partial air, we need to reserve slots in us-west-2 and update capacity plan. Those 3 nexday units should go into the GPU pool flagged for latency-critical customers; otherwise we risk missed SLAs.

ana_logistics: Customs note — the original shipment cleared in NL hub; split-air will create a secondary import in US. We need HS code reconfirmation and a proforma to avoid broker holdup. vendor rep, can you confirm HS and value for the air AWB?

tom_vendor: Hi all — HS is `8471.80` per our docs, declared value per unit $28,000 on proforma. We'll provide separate AWB `EX987654321US` for the 3 air units. Depot swap units will be shipped under RMA manifest with return AWB once depot accepted. Sorry for the DOA, we'll 100% credit freight on the urgent air.

liam_procurement: Re: credits — can we get a warranty credit for the 3 units and full freight reimbursement? ops wants a partial credit to cover replacement labor and expedited slotting. What number can vendor offer?

tom_vendor: We can offer full freight reimbursement and a 5% unit credit on the 3 replaced-by-air units; depot-repair units can get a 2% credit once validated. We can escalate to SRM for higher credit but need approval (24–48h).

maya_ops: 5% on air units is fine short-term if we get the replacements today. Need commitment that the 3 units are reserved and that serials won't be pulled for other customers. Also need `shipment-bot` to create a capacity change ticket so schedulers can reallocate.

shipment-bot: :package: Created ticket #INC-7421 — "Provision reserve: 3 expedited H100 replacements (AWB EX987654321US)". ETA update scheduled 2026-02-18 09:00 PST.

ana_logistics: Can vendor send the proforma + commercial invoice to customs@redwoodinfra.com and cc me? I’ll pre-clear and add broker code `RBW-04` to avoid delays. Also confirm whether air pieces are drop-shipped directly to our us-west-2 DC or to the freight forwarder.

tom_vendor: Sent proforma and CI to customs@redwoodinfra.com. Air will be direct to us-west-2 DC (no crossdock) per your request. Depot units go to our partner repair center in NL, we will coordinate RMA return labels.

liam_procurement: Ok locking this: accept split-air (3 units next-day to us-west-2), depot swap for 3 units ETA 7–10 business days, vendor credit: freight reimbursed + 5% on air units, 2% on depot units pending repair confirmation. Action items: vendor to confirm AWB/tracking, customs pre-clear by ana, ops reserve capacity.

maya_ops: I'll mark the 3 replacements as "hot" and shift canary traffic if needed. Please post AWB once available.

tom_vendor: AWB posted: `EX987654321US` — tracking live. Will update on depot repair status once units arrive at NL center.

liam_procurement: Thanks — closing for now. If SRM approves higher credit, we’ll reopen thread. :thumbsup:
